tools.name: DefenseClaw
tools.integration: agent hooks / plugins for 10 coding agents, LLM proxy, MCP and ACP routes

needs.rules: none (one Go binary, local, no model download)
needs.judge: an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (here Gemma 4 31B on Amazon Bedrock)

tools.name: Meta LlamaFirewall
tools.integration: Python library: the application calls scan() on each message

needs.promptguard: Hugging Face token with the Meta licence accepted; 1.1 GB (86M) or 0.3 GB (22M); CPU is enough
needs.alignmentcheck: an LLM API key (Together by default; Llama 4 Maverick); self-hosting Maverick needs a multi-GPU server

tools.name: Meta Llama Guard 4 12B
tools.integration: a model: serve it (vLLM) and call it per message

needs.model: Hugging Face token with the Meta licence accepted; 23 GB of weights; a GPU with 24 GB+ (here one L40S 48 GB)

tools.name: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails

surfaces.tool_call: structural (schema) only; injection YARA on arguments

tools.integration: Python library or guardrails server in front of the LLM

needs.jailbreak: gpt2-large (3.1 GB) for the heuristics, NemoGuard JailbreakDetect + Snowflake embedder (2 GB); the docs advise a separate server for production

tools.name: Invariant Guardrails
tools.integration: rules evaluated in the Invariant Gateway (LLM / MCP proxy) or with the Python analyzer; the package's default Policy class is the hosted service

tools.name: ProtectAI LLM Guard
tools.integration: Python library or API server: scan_prompt / scan_output

tools.name: IBM Granite Guardian 3.3 8B
tools.integration: a model: serve it (vLLM) and call it per message with a criteria id

needs.model: 16 GB of weights; a GPU with 24 GB+

tools.name: Qwen3Guard-Gen 8B
tools.integration: a model: serve it (vLLM / SGLang) and call it per message

needs.model: 16 GB of weights; a GPU with 24 GB+

selection: Competitors: the six named by the owner plus every open-source guard that, on 2026-11-13, had a release in the last 12 months, an OSI licence or open weights, wide use (Hugging Face downloads or GitHub stars) and documentation for prompt injection, jailbreak or agent / tool-call safety: IBM Granite Guardian 3.3 and Qwen3Guard-Gen. Not included: hosted-only services (Lakera, Azure Prompt Shields, Bedrock Guardrails), archived projects (Rebuff, Vigil), ShieldGemma and WildGuard (content moderation only, no agent placement), gpt-oss-safeguard (a bring-your-own-policy reasoning model with no published agent-security policy: any result would measure our policy text, not the tool).
